title: MOVE OpenLab method result
description: Value returned by solve(instance, config). Decisions are re-validated by the problem's validator; declared values are compared with the validator's, never trusted.

decisions.description: The problem's decision list (e.g. [driver_id, rider_id] pairs for ride matching).

status.description: Self-declared; OPTIMAL is a full-problem proof only for an exact method on an unpruned instance.

declared.description: Self-reported metric values by metric id.

metadata.description: Run information, e.g. solver name and version, solver_time_s.
